data.name: Benkley
data.long_meaning: The name Benkley is derived from the Old English words 'ben' meaning 'hill' and 'cleh' meaning 'cliff' or 'rock'. This name can be interpreted as 'son of the hill' or 'son of the rock'. In Christian tradition, this name may be associated with the biblical figure Ben-Hur, who was a nobleman of the ancient city of Jerusalem and a protagonist in the novel 'Ben-Hur: A Tale of the Christ' by Lew Wallace.
